concepts.name: 원형 ㅎ
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: review-only design board for the Korean macOS automatic Korean/English input method brand "한녕".
Create ONE landscape 3:2 comparison board on a pure white background. LEFT: a large macOS app icon, front-facing rounded square tile, centered mark. RIGHT: the SAME exact mark as a pure black monochrome menu-bar input-source symbol on white, no tile around the menu mark. The mark on the right must faithfully match the silhouette inside the app icon, not a different logo. The two occupy equal halves with wide whitespace and balanced visual size; the right monochrome mark is smaller than the left app icon, but large enough to inspect. Flat precise graphic design, crisp vector-like edges, sophisticated restrained utility software brand, inspired only by Rime/Squirrel's single-bold-symbol clarity and Kawa's minimalism. Do not reproduce their actual logos. Korean consonant geometry must be correct: ㅎ has a short horizontal cap, a longer horizontal stroke below, then a closed counter below those bars; ㄴ is a left upright descending into a horizontal base extending right. No mascot, smile, face, cute styling, glossy 3D, keyboard illustration, arrows, gradients, drop shadow, Latin H, Latin A, or invented Latin substitute. No headings, captions, numbered labels, brand name, watermarks, additional icons, or explanatory text. Show only the app tile and the corresponding monochrome symbol.
Primary request: An instantly recognizable custom Korean ㅎ symbol with a perfectly round bottom counter. Two bold straight horizontal strokes above the ring: top stroke short, second stroke wide. All strokes have uniform weight and subtly rounded terminals. Confident balanced modern Hangul typography; the circle is not a face. Keep generous counter space so the mark survives at 16 points. App tile warm off-white, mark near-black charcoal. The right mark is black. This is the clean, typographic standalone ㅎ concept.
